g.text: 04 / What do revisits add on the same recorded motion?

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #8aa9c9

g.text: Cyan: normal SLAM replay • amber: revisits denied after a 5 s observation gap • identical observations and applied controls

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #8aa9c9

g.text: Dotted lines: accepted revisit packets. Absolute map error need not improve for every seed; the initial pose prior anchors the frame.
